Directory: packages/@dicebear/notionists-neutral/src/components/

parts.js contains these SVG fragments, in this fixed order:
  brows.ts: variant13, variant12, variant09, variant10
  eyes.ts: variant05, variant04, variant03
  nose.ts: variant06, variant16, variant17
  lips.ts: variant30, variant25, variant17, variant04

Path geometry and internal fills are unchanged. TideStat adds the circular paper
background, selects variants with its own stable ID hash, and retains the original
560 x 560 canvas and component offsets from src/index.ts. The TypeScript component
wrappers are replaced by small ES-module arrays; there is no runtime DiceBear API.
This is a curated local adaptation, not the complete upstream generator; its seed
mapping is TideStat's own and is not promised to match DiceBear's public API.
